system.description:
You focus on manifesting your Yin Release in the exact way another nature release would manifest, conjuring a surge of black chakra that behaves like your chosen release to emulate. Select one of nature release, and then a point you can see within range, as a wave of black chakra erupts with the properties of the chosen release, forcing all creatures in range to make a Dexterity saving throw.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 3d6 Necrotic damage

Failure: Affected creatures takes 3d6 Necrotic damage, and gains 1 rank of the chosen releases condition.

Earth Release: Shaken

Wind Release: Bleed

Fire Release: Burned

Water Release: Chilled

Lightning Release: Shocked.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they take 5d6 Necrotic damage.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and the damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or higher, increase the ranks of the chosen releases condition by +1. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, increase the ranks of the chosen releases condition by +1.
